notes.chemistry: Checked every option and reaction condition. Carbonate + calcium hydroxide excludes excess CO2; CuO is not treated as soluble/amphoteric; nitrate is not split into N/O ions. Reagent-pair items require BOTH reactions; alternative distinguishing reagents are explicitly considered. NH4+ + OH− needs warming. First identification item compares appearance/gas, not white precipitate shades; sufficient concentrations declared. Oxidation states and electron directions independently recomputed where numerical. This is finite editorial QA, not a general chemistry theorem prover.
notes.biology: Checked all organisms, every A/B statement and all distractors. Birds/placental mammals develop directly; frog, butterfly and perch have larval stages. Mature HUMAN erythrocytes specified; epithelial cell specified so absence of a nucleus in an erythrocyte cannot create ambiguity. Peripheral nodes/nerves distinguished from CNS; pulmonary vessels classified by circuit rather than oxygen content. Gaps refer to the four explicit letters, not sentence numbers. No image-dependent slot is replaced by a text question.
notes.social-studies: Checked definitions, all four alternatives and A/B truth combinations. Status and role distinguished; vertical/horizontal mobility constraints explicit; regime, form of government and territorial structure not conflated. Law questions ask stable school concepts; no case-specific legal advice. Constitution facts: article15 supremacy, article20 life, article32 electoral rights, article110 executive power. External expert validation not performed.
